name: Rule: 1.1.1
recommendation_text: 1.1.1 Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for lung cancer if they: have chest X‑ray findings that suggest lung cancer, or are aged 40 and over with unexplained haemoptysis. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.1.2
recommendation_text: 1.1.2 Offer an urgent , direct access chest X‑ray to assess for lung cancer in people aged 40 and over if they have 2 or more of the following unexplained symptoms, or if they have ever smoked and have 1 or more of the following unexplained symptoms: cough fatigue shortness of breath chest pain weight loss appetite loss. [2015]

recommendation_structure.lead_text: Offer an urgent , direct access chest X‑ray to assess for lung cancer in people aged 40 and over if they have 2 or more of the following unexplained symptoms, or if they have ever smoked and have 1 or more of the following unexplained symptoms:

items.text: cough
fatigue
shortness of breath
chest pain
weight loss
appetite loss. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.1.6
recommendation_text: 1.1.6 Consider an urgent , direct access chest X‑ray to assess for mesothelioma in people aged 40 and over with either: finger clubbing or chest signs compatible with pleural disease. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.10.5
recommendation_text: 1.10.5 Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral if the results of the blood tests outlined in recommendation 1.10.4 suggest myeloma. [2015, amended 2025]

name: Rule: 1.11.4
recommendation_text: 1.11.4 Consider an urgent , direct access ultrasound scan to assess for soft tissue sarcoma in adults with an unexplained lump that is increasing in size. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.2.11

name: Rule: 1.2.2

name: Rule: 1.2.3

name: Rule: 1.4.1
recommendation_text: 1.4.1 Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for breast cancer if they are: aged 30 and over and have an unexplained breast lump with or without pain, or aged 50 and over with any of the following symptoms in 1 nipple only: discharge retraction other changes of concern. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.4.2
recommendation_text: 1.4.2 Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for breast cancer in people: with skin changes that suggest breast cancer, or aged 30 and over with an unexplained lump in the axilla. [2015]

name: Rule: 1.4.3
recommendation_text: 1.4.3 Consider non-urgent referral in people aged under 30 with an unexplained breast lump with or without pain. For information about seeking specialist advice, see also recommendations 1.16.2 and 1.16.3 in the section on the diagnostic process . [2015]

name: Rule: 1.5.1
recommendation_text: 1.5.1 Make a referral to a gynaecological cancer service using a suspected cancer pathway referral if physical examination identifies ascites and/or a pelvic or abdominal mass (which is not obviously uterine fibroids). [2011, amended 2020]

name: Rule: 1.5.2
recommendation_text: 1.5.2 Carry out tests in primary care (see recommendations 1.5.6 to 1.5.9) if a woman, or a trans man or non-binary person with female reproductive organs (especially if they are aged 50 or over) reports having any of the following symptoms on a persistent or frequent basis – particularly more than 12 times per month: persistent abdominal distension (often referred to as 'bloating') feeling full (early satiety) and/or loss of appetite pelvic or abdominal pain increased urinary urgency and/or frequency. [2011]

recommendation_structure.lead_text: Carry out tests in primary care (see recommendations 1.5.6 to 1.5.9) if a woman, or a trans man or non-binary person with female reproductive organs (especially if they are aged 50 or over) reports having any of the following symptoms on a persistent or frequent basis – particularly more than 12 times per month:

items.text: persistent abdominal distension (often referred to as 'bloating')
feeling full (early satiety) and/or loss of appetite
pelvic or abdominal pain
increased urinary urgency and/or frequency. [2011]

name: Rule: 1.5.3
recommendation_text: 1.5.3 Consider carrying out tests in primary care (see recommendations 1.5.6 to 1.5.9) if a woman, or a trans man or non-binary person with female reproductive organs reports unexplained weight loss, fatigue or changes in bowel habit. [2011]

name: Rule: 1.5.9
recommendation_text: 1.5.9 Arrange an urgent , direct access ultrasound scan of the abdomen and pelvis depending on age and serum CA125 according to the thresholds in table 1. [2026]

name: Rule: 1.8.5
recommendation_text: 1.8.5 Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for thyroid cancer in people with an unexplained thyroid lump. [2015]
